name: Student/Research/Internship Pass

requirements.blocker_text: Accepted as a student by an approved Educational or Training Establishment, evidenced by a detailed institutional cover letter (Form 30) to the Director of Immigration Services.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission at an approved Kenyan institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Proof of funds required for self-sponsored students; sponsored students require a sponsor's commitment letter and the sponsor's passport copy.

evidence_required.document: Proof of funds or sponsor's commitment letter
Research permit from the National Council for Science and Technology (research track only)

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the source located in this build; renewed via progress reports/transcripts

sources.title: Foreign Nationals Services (eFNS), Directorate of Immigration Services, Republic of Kenya -- Student/Research/Internship Pass: requires Form 30 institutional cover letter, passport, police clearance certificate, proof of funds or sponsor commitment (self-sponsored vs sponsored), academic certificates, school registration certificate from the Ministry of Education; research track requires a National Council for Science and Technology research permit; applied for via the eFNS portal after Government of Kenya Single Sign-On registration

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kenya). Published on tier-1 sourcing (the Directorate of Immigration Services' own eFNS portal). Duration/validity period was not specified in the source retrieved; renewal is evidenced by progress reports/transcripts rather than a fixed term, disclosed as a gap rather than guessed.
